headline: Home sales hit
*a 16-year low*
slides.fig_caption: Annualized pace of existing-home sales in October
slides.sub: The slowest month since August 2010, with 30-year rates averaging 7.33%.

slides.title: Sales drop, *by region*
slides.note: Year-over-year change in sales pace. *Midwest median price still rose 1.5%* to $324,300.

slides.title: The market *mix shifts*
points: *First-time buyers:* 29% of sales, down from 32% a year ago.
*Prices:* median $416,700, up 0.4% for a 40th straight annual gain.

slides.title: Slower sales, *steady prices*
slides.body: More supply and a 35-day median time on market give buyers room to negotiate, but values aren't falling. Price listings to today's pace, and keep sidelined buyers warm: NAR sees pent-up demand if rates ease.
